reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, batch 4

competency_fulfillment.rationale: Competency requires both addition AND subtraction of similar (same-denominator) fractions, but all 5 samples show only addition (1/8+7/8, 1/4+2/4, 1/8+2/8, 1/6+4/6, 1/10+7/10); no subtraction example appears anywhere.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: variant_registry lists 9 combos across 3 axes for fractions, but the 5 samples given are addition-only, so subtraction coverage within those combos can't be confirmed from what was shown.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The fraction-addition prompts are short single-expression questions well within grade-3 reading level and represent a single-step computation.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Denominators vary nicely (4, 6, 8, 10) showing same-denominator ('similar') fraction addition, but the complete absence of a subtraction sample limits confidence the registered variant space covers the full add-and-subtract scope.

competency_alignment.rationale: All fractions shown share a common denominator (i.e. 'similar' fractions) and never introduce unlike-denominator addition, correctly scoping this node below unlike-fraction operations that belong to a later grade/quarter.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The fraction denominators (4 through 10) and simple numerators are an appropriate progression for grade-3 quarter-4 introductory fraction operations.
